title: Software Engineering for AI-Driven Science
abstract: arXiv:2610.34573v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI has made significant contributions to scientific discovery. Autonomous agents can now independently analyse complex problems, design experiments, write and execute code, analyse findings, and derive scientific conclusions. Nevertheless, errors in AI-generated code, experimental procedures, or evidence interpretation can lead to invalid research conclusions, undermining the reliability and reproducibility of automated scientific discovery. In this vision paper, we propose Software Engineering for AI-Driven Science (SE4AI4Sci) as an emerging research area for addressing this challenge. As an organising framework, we introduce the Scientific Assurance Chain, connecting intent, experimental design, implementation, execution, evidence, and claim. translated_title: 面向AI驱动科学的软件工程
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）已为科学发现做出了重大贡献。自主智能体如今能够独立分析复杂问题、设计实验、编写并执行代码、分析研究结果并推导出科学结论。然而，AI生成的代码、实验流程或证据解读中的错误可能导致无效的研究结论，损害自动化科学发现的可靠性与可复现性。在这篇愿景论文中，我们提出“面向AI驱动科学的软件工程”（SE4AI4Sci）作为一个新兴研究领域，以应对这一挑战。作为组织框架，我们引入了“科学保证链”，将意图、实验设计、实现、执行、证据与结论断言连接起来。通过对近期AI for Science系统中六个有记录的失败案例的分析，我们展示了该链条可能在何处断裂、现有保证机制在何处不足，以及由此带来的新研究挑战。我们还……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出“面向AI驱动科学的软件工程”（SE4AI4Sci）这一新兴研究方向，通过“科学保证链”框架和六个真实失败案例分析，指出了保障AI驱动科学发现可靠性与可复现性的关键研究挑战。
en_tdlr: This vision paper proposes Software Engineering for AI-Driven Science (SE4AI4Sci) as an emerging research area, introducing the Scientific Assurance Chain framework and analyzing six documented failures to identify key challenges in ensuring the reliability and reproducibility of AI-driven scientific discovery.
